---
title: "progenitors_integration_trial"
output: html_document
---

Integrate donors using RPCA, FastMNN and Harmony

Updating to run v5 of seurat. (based on original seurat_sct_integration_no_introns)

```{r params}
module="progenitors"
dataname = "integration_trial"
library(here); i_am(file.path("analysis",paste(module,sep="_",
                                               paste0(dataname, ".Rmd"))))
indir = here("output", module, "initial")
odir = here("output", module, dataname) 

load_data = T #Loading initial seurat analysis
subset_data = T 

if (!dir.exists(odir)){dir.create(odir, recursive = T)}
```

```{r libs, warning=F, message=F, echo=F}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsci)

library(Seurat)
library(BPCells)
library(patchwork)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)

pal = c("#DA1819", "#00AED1", "#434D51","#EBB400","#691A93","#3AAD00")
clusters = ggsci::pal_simpsons()(12)[c(1:7,9:12)]
```

## Read data

```{r load_data}
if (subset_data){
  filt = readRDS(here(indir, "10%_complete_analysis.rds"))
  Idents(filt) = "seurat_clusters"
} else{
  filt = readRDS(here(indir, "complete_analysis.rds"))
}

filt[["RNA"]] <- split(filt[["RNA"]], f = filt$orig.ident)
filt
head(filt@meta.data) 
```

```{r}
filt$initial_clusters = filt$seurat_clusters
filt[["initial.umap"]] = filt[["umap"]]
```

```{r}
DimPlot(filt, cols=clusters, label=T)
```


## RPCA Integration

```{r setup-variables-rpca}
method_name="rpca"
red_name = paste("pca", sep=".", method_name)
umap_name = paste("umap", sep=".", method_name)
clu_name = paste( method_name, sep="_", "clusters")
```

```{r}
filt = IntegrateLayers(filt, method= RPCAIntegration, orig.reduction = "pca",
                       new.reduction = red_name)
```

```{r basic_analysis}
filt <- FindNeighbors(filt, reduction =  red_name, dims = 1:20, verbose=F)
filt <- FindClusters(filt, resolution = 0.5, cluster.name =  clu_name)
filt <- RunUMAP(filt, reduction = red_name, dims = 1:20, reduction.name = umap_name)
```

```{r}
DimPlot(filt, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = clu_name, label=T)
DimPlot(filt, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = "orig.ident", label=T, cols=pal, label.color = "white", label.box = T)
DimPlot(filt, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = "initial_clusters", label=T, cols=clusters)
DimPlot(filt, reduction = "initial.umap",  group.by = clu_name, label=T)
```

## FastMNN

```{r setup-variables-fastmnn}
method_name="fastmnn"
red_name = paste("pca", sep=".", method_name)
umap_name = paste("umap", sep=".", method_name)
clu_name = paste( method_name, sep="_", "clusters")
```

```{r}
filt = IntegrateLayers(filt, method= FastMNNIntegration, orig.reduction = "pca",
                       new.reduction = red_name)
```

```{r basic_analysis}
filt <- FindNeighbors(filt, reduction =  red_name, dims = 1:20, verbose=F)
filt <- FindClusters(filt, resolution = 0.5, cluster.name =  clu_name)
filt <- RunUMAP(filt, reduction = red_name, dims = 1:20, reduction.name = umap_name)
```

```{r}
DimPlot(filt, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = clu_name, label=T)

```

```{r save}
if (subset_data == FALSE){
  saveRDS(norm, file = file.path(odir,dataname, "complete_analysis.rds"))
  sub = subset(norm, downsample=1000)
  saveRDS(sub,file.path(odir,dataname, "10%_complete_analysis.rds"))
} else if (subset_data){ #if subset, don't save complete analysis
  saveRDS(norm,file.path(odir,dataname, "10%_subset_analysis.rds"))
}
```
